posts.title: Bipolar Overlap Masterclass

summary_en: A free 6-hour live masterclass from eCare Behavioral Health Institute, presented by Jim Phelps, MD, a psychiatrist specialising in complex mood disorders and author of A Spectrum Approach to Mood Disorders. It teaches therapists how to tell bipolar disorder apart from depression with PTSD, ADHD, generalised anxiety and borderline personality disorder, using the Four A's (anxiety, anger, agitation, attention problems), side-by-side comparisons, mixed features, and simplified Social Rhythm Therapy, plus lower-risk treatment choices while the diagnosis is still uncertain. Held Tuesday 8 December 2026, 10:00-17:30 Eastern Time (23:00 Hong Kong/Macau time on 8 December to 06:30 on 9 December), fully online, free to attend, in English, with advance registration required. Lifetime recording access and 6 CEs require a paid Premium Pass upgrade. Aimed at licensed mental health professionals including psychologists, counsellors, social workers and marriage and family therapists.
summary_zh: eCare Behavioral Health Institute 免費 6 小時網上大師班，由情緒障礙專家 Jim Phelps 醫生（《A Spectrum Approach to Mood Disorders》作者）主講，教治療師分辨躁鬱與抑鬱、PTSD、ADHD、焦慮症及邊緣型人格障礙：四個 A（焦慮、憤怒、激動、注意力問題）、逐項比較、混合特徵、簡化版社交節律治療，以及診斷未明時的低風險治療選擇。2026 年 12 月 8 日（星期二）美東時間 10:00–17:30 舉行（香港／澳門時間 12 月 8 日 23:00 至 12 月 9 日 6:30），全程線上直播，免費參加，全程英語，須預先報名。錄影重溫及 6 CE 學分須付費升級 Premium Pass。對象為持牌精神健康專業人員，包括心理學家、輔導員、社工及婚姻家庭治療師。
